tagline: European association representing the interests of inland shipping, insurance, and ship survey sectors
hero_kpi_rationale: 225 Congress participants reflect the commitment and representativeness of the pan-European IVR network in the inland shipping sector, bringing together transportation professionals, insurance and ship survey experts from 11 European countries

kpis.name: Annual Congress Participants
kpis.explanation: Total number of participants attending the annual IVR Congress from member countries and associated organizations.
kpis.description: Participants to the 2024 Annual Congress held in Frankfurt am Main (May 15-17, 2024), representing shipping industry, insurance and ship survey from 11 European countries.
kpis.signal: Strong international participation demonstrating network vitality and sector engagement across 11 countries

kpis.name: Loss Prevention Colloquium Participants
kpis.explanation: Number of participants attending the inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium organized by IVR to discuss technical and financial aspects of loss prevention in European inland shipping.
kpis.description: Inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium held in Antwerp on November 4, 2024, with participants from Belgium, Netherlands, and Germany discussing technical and financial aspects of loss prevention in European inland shipping.
kpis.signal: Inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium successfully launched with strong participation from insurance and maritime professionals

kpis.name: CESNI Committee Sessions Attended by IVR
kpis.explanation: Number of European Committee for the Development of Standards in the Inland Navigation sector (CESNI) sessions attended by IVR as observer, contributing to harmonization of regulations across European member states.
kpis.description: IVR participated as observer in CESNI working group and committee sessions (April 11, 2024 and October 17, 2024) contributing to harmonization of technical regulations, professional qualifications standards, and digitalization across European member states.
kpis.signal: Active participation in European standardization processes for inland waterway transport technical regulations and professional qualifications
